messages:
sophia: Quick sync — follow-up from last night's inference-gateway incident. We saw recurring 99th percentile latency spikes across multiple pods, and the error budget for the month is now at 42%. We need clear owners and a timeline for SLO/SLA updates and remediation tasks.

aj: Agreed. Initial root cause looks like slow KV cache misses + sudden burst of long context requests. Will propose short-term mitigations and a plan for hardening autoscaling.

maria: I can own the dashboard + alert tuning work. Plan: add p50/p95/p99 panels and an 'SLO burn' panel, and lower noisy alert sensitivity. Target: dashboard PR in 3 business days. :calendar:

lee: I'll take autoscaling config + cache sizing changes. Quick mitigation: increase max replicas for gateway and add a conservative burst policy. I'll test on staging today.

aj: ACTION:aj - run regression on cache-miss hot paths, share flamegraphs by EOD tomorrow.

maria: ACTION:maria - create dashboard PR with sample queries and screenshots by Thu 2024-07-04.

lee: ACTION:lee - autoscale config + canary deploy plan by next Tue. Will include replica caps and grace periods.

product-ops: FYI we may need to update SLA wording if monthly error budget moves frequently. Can you flag proposed SLA text changes once you have numbers?

sophia: For SLOs: proposal from last call was to set SLOs to p95 < 250ms, p99 < 500ms for the inference-gateway 1s window. Do we want to adjust that or keep and change alerts?

aj: I think we should keep current SLO thresholds for now but change the alerting and add an automated fallback to a lower-cost model variant when p99 > 750ms for >5m. That reduces customer impact.

maria: Dashboard queries I'll include (Prometheus examples):
```
# SLI: request latency p99 over 1m window
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference-gateway"}[5m])) by (le))
# SLO burn: percentage of good requests over 30d
(sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference-gateway", le!="+Inf"}[30d])) - sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference-gateway", le>="0.5"}[30d]))) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference-gateway"}[30d]))
```

lee: Nice. I'll make sure autoscale decisions emit a metric so we can correlate scale events with p99 spikes. ACTION:lee - add scale_event metric in canary.

incident-bot: Incident #2024-06-19-IGW: acknowledged. Postmortem draft created: /pm/2024-06-19-inference-gateway-draft (owner: aj).

sophia: Good. Two more items: 1) schedule a 30-min follow-up review next week to validate fixes (owner: aj). 2) add a recurring 90-day pattern review to check for regressions (owner: maria + eng-sre).

aj: I'll schedule the 30-min review — aiming Wed 2024-07-03 10:00 PT. Also will post action tracker table in the PM doc.

maria: Quick note on alerts: lowering sensitivity will reduce noise but we must keep a high-severity path for real SLO breaches. I'll propose a split: page on sustained p99>750ms for 5m, warn on p99>500ms for 3m.

lee: ETA for staging canary is Friday. If tests pass, prod canary over weekend, full rollout next week.

product-ops: Please capture any SLA wording changes as a diff. We'll review with legal if it affects commitments.

sophia: Recap: owners set - aj (postmortem + follow-up review + regression), maria (dashboard + alerts), lee (autoscale + metrics), product-ops (SLA wording). Deadlines: dashboard PR in 3 business days, autoscale canary by Fri, follow-up review Wed. If anyone can't meet the timeline, flag now. :eyes:

aj: I can meet those. Marking as blocked if we hit infra quota limits — will call it out ASAP.

maria: PR link when ready will be posted here. Also adding a 'slo-runbook' section to the PM doc with quick rollback/playbook steps.

sophia: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll close this thread and move action items into the postmortem tracker. :thumbsup:
